name: Immune Dysregulation-Inflammatory Bowel Disease-Arthritis-Recurrent Infections-Lymphopenia Syndrome

diagnosticCriteria.formalCriteriaName: Proposed Diagnostic Criteria for Immune Dysregulation-IBD-Arthritis-Recurrent Infections-Lymphopenia Syndrome

criteria.description: Presence of chronic inflammatory bowel disease confirmed by endoscopy and histology
Non-infectious arthritis involving peripheral joints documented clinically and/or radiologically
History of recurrent bacterial, viral, or fungal infections requiring medical intervention
Persistent lymphopenia documented on at least two separate occasions
Laboratory evidence of immune dysregulation such as abnormal cytokine profiles or autoantibodies

diagnosticCriteria.minimumForDiagnosis: All four major criteria (chronic IBD, arthritis, recurrent infections, and persistent lymphopenia) must be present
diagnosticCriteria.notes: Diagnosis requires exclusion of other primary immunodeficiencies and autoimmune disorders

pathognomonic.symptomName: Chronic inflammatory bowel disease with granulomatous inflammation
searchTerms: inflammatory bowel disease with granuloma formation

pathognomonic.symptomName: Persistent lymphopenia with reduced CD4+ T-cell counts
searchTerms: low lymphocyte counts with reduced CD4 cells
persistent low white blood cells affecting immunity
lymphopenia with decreased helper T cells

pathognomonic.symptomName: Recurrent severe bacterial and viral infections

common.symptomName: Symmetric polyarthritis affecting small and large joints
searchTerms: joint inflammation affecting many joints symmetrically
arthritis in small and large joints
chronic diarrhea accompanied by abdominal cramps

common.symptomName: Failure to thrive or growth retardation in pediatric patients

searchTerms: repeated chest infections leading to bronchial widening

laboratory: Persistent lymphopenia with decreased CD4+ and CD8+ T-cell subsets
Presence of autoantibodies (ANA, rheumatoid factor) in some cases
imaging: Abdominal imaging may show bowel wall thickening consistent with IBD
Chest CT may reveal bronchiectasis in recurrent pulmonary infections
other: Endoscopic biopsy showing granulomatous inflammation in intestinal mucosa

distinguishingFeatures: Less frequent arthritis and IBD-like symptoms
Arthritis precedes or coincides with IBD onset
No persistent lymphopenia or recurrent severe infections
Recurrent infections but not typically associated with lymphopenia or arthritis

redFlags: Early onset chronic inflammatory bowel disease with granulomas
